messages:
Alice Kim: Ran a replay A/B comparing current queue policy (fixed token_budget=512) vs new adaptive token-target that uses seq-length quantiles and kv-hit hints. Short summary: avg cost down ~8% for mixed chat workloads but p95 latency regressed on long-retain contexts (>=4k).
Ravi Patel: can you paste the exact replay cmd + config you used? want to reproduce locally.
Alice Kim: replayer --trace=prod-trace-2026-02-18 --policy=adaptive-target-v3 --seed=42 --kernels=auto
Alice Kim: config excerpt: ```policy: adaptive-target-v3 token_budget_percentile: 90 kv_prefetch_threshold: 0.35 batcher.max_batch_tokens: 2048 kernel_select.mode: latency_cost_tradeoff```
Sofia Chen: quick note — regression seems correlated with kernel selection flipping from q4_matmul -> q8_fused_matmul at small batch sizes due to our cost model using per-token avg, which doesn't reflect kv-cache-induced backend stalls.
Diego Morales: saw similar in profiler: when kv-hit ratio drops below 0.7 we get 20-40% more stall time waiting for KV warmup. snippet: "kernel_choice=q8_fused_matmul, batch_size=3, kv_hit=0.62, backend_wait=12.3ms"
Eli Zhang: perf-bot flagged a regression earlier today for kernel-change path, linking the CI replay run: https://perf.redwood/internal/replays/1840100000
perf-bot: ALERT: replay-run adaptive-target-v3 produced p95_latency_delta +19% (baseline fixed-512) on 8k-retain cohort. Regression tag: kernel-mismatch-kv.
Ravi Patel: hypothesis: our kernel selection cost model needs a kv-aware component and a batch-size term. Right now it assumes linear per-token cost; for small batches kernel startup dominates.
Alice Kim: agree. Proposed fixes: 1) augment kernel cost model with kernel_startup_ms * (1/batch_size_weighted) 2) feed kv-hit ratio (from trace) to selection logic 3) add a safety floor: if estimated latency > SLA threshold fallback to smaller but more predictable kernel.
Sofia Chen: for offline tuning, we should add an AB run that forces kernel_select.mode=kv_aware and measure p50/p95 + token_cost. Also add a replay flag that artificially simulates cold-kv sequences to stress warmup paths.
Diego Morales: I can update the trace-replayer to inject kv_hit noise. patch ready: ```+--kv-noise=p0.1 --kv-cold-samples=200```
Eli Zhang: could we try a mixed evaluation harness: N=5000 traces, run both policies, and compute per-trace delta as well as cohort aggregates (short/med/long seq). Need to log kernel chosen per inference.
Alice Kim: yes — that's how I computed initial numbers. I will extend logging to include kernel_choice, estimated_cost, observed_latency_ms, kv_hit.
Ravi Patel: plan + owners?
Alice Kim: I'll own replay runs and add kernel-aware cost model prototype. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial numbers.
Sofia Chen: I'll modify the AB harness to sample cold-kv and produce cohort reports.
Diego Morales: I'll land kv-noise support and update the offline sim doc.
Eli Zhang: I'll add a quick guard in runtime: if batch_size < 4 and kv_hit < 0.5 prefer low-startup kernel; we can enable as canary behind feature flag.
perf-bot: NOTE: created ticket PERF-1129 linking replay output and profiler snippets.
Alice Kim: thanks — next step: run 5k-trace AB overnight, post results in morning. if regression persists we'll iterate on kernel_startup estimate and fallback thresholds. :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: thanks all. small ask — include cost delta (tokens * $unit) and recommended rollout (canary percent) in the report.
Alice Kim: will do.```
